summary: Make private security reporting and solo-maintainer response explicit
details: Route suspected vulnerabilities directly to verified GitHub private reporting and ordinary support to GitHub issues.
Document the named response owner, best-effort availability, severity triage, patch and emergency response, advisory contents, credit consent and coordinated disclosure.
Reuse the release-linked machine-readable support window and record a synthetic desk exercise with provider and delivery limits explicit.

compatibility.notes: Documentation and issue-contact navigation only; no provider setting, release selector or runtime behavior changed.

security: Keep vulnerability details, credentials and customer evidence in private reporting. Emergency fixes preserve required CI, publisher identity checks and immutable published evidence.
limitations: One maintainer provides best-effort response without a fixed SLA, backup or advertised domain mailbox.
Provider enablement and a Codex desk exercise do not prove notification delivery, human on-call coverage or a real advisory publication.
